X.note: Dark, clean 3D bars on a grid floor, but the 13% label card is semi-transparent and overlaps the green cube, so its text is washed out. Labels cover the bars they describe. The three bars are nearly the same size, so they don't match 7% vs 6% vs 13%. The 'ACTUAL' badge is repeated four times and means nothing to a viewer. The bottom caption is large, but the frame reads as a slide with some boxes.

Y.note: Good terrain map with a river and shaded relief. The coins have white outlines and clean shadows, so they look like polished 3D objects and stand out against the green. The only text is a small source line, so there is no number, label or place name. The viewer can't tell what the five coins stand for or where this is. There is a dark gradient band at the bottom.

why: Y looks more cinematic and has no broken text, though it is too unlabeled to explain anything. X's overlapping, ghosted 13% label and mismatched bars hurt its comprehension.
top_fix_for_weaker: In X, make the 13% card opaque and move it clear of the green cube. Put each label above or beside its own bar without covering it. Scale the bar heights to 7/6/13, and remove the repeated 'ACTUAL' badges.
